summary.text: Jade Sooktis is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 41, first elected in 2024, and is the Democratic candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sooktis won the 2024 general election for the open District 41 seat, defeating Da Wallowing Bull and Rae Peppers, with 63.8 percent of the vote.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House State Administration Committee and the Human Services Committee.
She was unopposed in the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary.
